verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document how Moosend segments are built. Segments appear only in a billing note (docs-3), and a vague claim about targeting with data insights (docs-11) does not describe criteria. Nothing shows segments built from profile attributes, tags, or behavioral events, or that segments update live as data changes.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes
